description: Unit test class for ProjectDao in the OrangeHRM Time plugin; tests various CRUD and reporting functionalities related to project data.

classes.name: ProjectDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ProjectDao functionalities, including project CRUD operations and report generation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, including instantiating ProjectDao, cleaning tables, and loading fixture data.

methods.name: testAddProject
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new Project instance through ProjectDao.

methods.name: testGetProjects
methods.description: Tests retrieval of projects with default filter parameters.

methods.name: testFilterProjectByCustomerOrProjectName
methods.description: Verifies filtering projects by customer or project name.

methods.name: testFilterProjectByExcludeProjectIds
methods.description: Checks filtering projects by excluding specific project IDs.

methods.name: testGetProjectById
methods.description: Asserts fetching a project by its ID returns correct data.

methods.name: testUpdateProject
methods.description: Tests updating an existing project and verifying changes.

methods.name: testDeleteProjects
methods.description: Tests deletion of projects by IDs.

methods.name: testIsProjectNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if the system correctly identifies an existing project name.

methods.name: testIsProjectAdmin
methods.description: Verifies if specific employee IDs are recognized as project admins.

methods.name: testGetProjectIdList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of project IDs, including handling of deleted projects and empty results.

methods.name: testGetProjectIdListForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Checks obtaining project IDs accessible by specific project admins.

methods.name: testGetProjectReportCriteriaListAndTotalHours
methods.description: Verifies report criteria list and total hours calculation for a project under various filters.

methods.name: testGetProjectReportCriteriaListCount
methods.description: Tests counting report criteria list entries with specific filters.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleEmpNumbersForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Checks the list of employee numbers accessible to a project admin.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityDetailedReportCriteriaListAndTotalHours
methods.description: Verifies detailed report list and total hours calculation for project activities with filters.
